verses.he: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרֹומִמְךָ֣ אֱלֹוהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעֹולָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.ar: تَسْبِيحَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ أَرْفَعُكَ يَا إِلَهِي ٱلْمَلِكَ، وَأُبَارِكُ ٱسْمَكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: A Psalm of praise; of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O King; and I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.kjv: David’s [Psalm] of praise. I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.web: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

verses.he: בְּכָל־יֹ֥ום אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעֹולָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.ar: فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أُبَارِكُكَ، وَأُسَبِّحُ ٱسْمَكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: Every day will I bless Thee; and I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.kjv: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.web: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

verses.he: גָּ֘דֹ֤ול יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּתֹ֗ו אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.ar: عَظِيمٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ وَحَمِيدٌ جِدًّا، وَلَيْسَ لِعَظَمَتِهِ ٱسْتِقْصَاءٌ.
verses.en: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; and His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.kjv: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness [is] unsearchable.
verses.web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

verses.he: דֹּ֣ור לְ֭דֹור יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃
verses.ar: دَوْرٌ إِلَى دَوْرٍ يُسَبِّحُ أَعْمَالَكَ، وَبِجَبَرُوتِكَ يُخْبِرُونَ.
verses.en: One generation shall laud Thy works to another, and shall declare Thy mighty acts.
verses.kjv: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.web: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

verses.he: הֲ֭דַר כְּבֹ֣וד הֹודֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאֹותֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.ar: بِجَلَالِ مَجْدِ حَمْدِكَ وَأُمُورِ عَجَائِبِكَ أَلْهَجُ.
verses.en: The glorious splendour of Thy majesty, and Thy wondrous works, will I rehearse.
verses.kjv: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.web: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

verses.he: וֶעֱז֣וּז נֹורְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ *וּגְדוּלֹּתֶיךָ (וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ֥) אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.ar: بِقُوَّةِ مَخَاوِفِكَ يَنْطِقُونَ، وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ أُحَدِّثُ.
verses.en: And men shall speak of the might of Thy tremendous acts; and I will tell of Thy greatness.
verses.kjv: And [men] shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.web: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

verses.he: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: ذِكْرَ كَثْرَةِ صَلَاحِكَ يُبْدُونَ، وَبِعَدْلِكَ يُرَنِّمُونَ.
verses.en: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, and shall sing of Thy righteousness.
verses.kjv: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.web: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

verses.he: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־חָֽסֶד׃
verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ حَنَّانٌ وَرَحِيمٌ، طَوِيلُ ٱلرُّوحِ وَكَثِيرُ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ.
verses.en: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.web: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

verses.he: טֹוב־יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ صَالِحٌ لِلْكُلِّ، وَمَرَاحِمُهُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَعْمَالِهِ.
verses.en: The LORD is good to all; and His tender mercies are over all His works.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] good to all: and his tender mercies [are] over all his works.
verses.web: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.he: יֹוד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃
verses.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ كُلُّ أَعْمَالِكَ، وَيُبَارِكُكَ أَتْقِيَاؤُكَ.
verses.en: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O LORD; and Thy saints shall bless Thee.
verses.kjv: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.web: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

verses.he: כְּבֹ֣וד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: بِمَجْدِ مُلْكِكَ يَنْطِقُونَ، وَبِجَبَرُوتِكَ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ،
verses.en: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, and talk of Thy might;
verses.kjv: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.web: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

verses.he: לְהֹודִ֤יעַ ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְבֹ֗וד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِيُعَرِّفُوا بَنِي آدَمَ قُدْرَتَكَ وَمَجْدَ جَلَالِ مُلْكِكَ.
verses.en: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, and the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.
verses.kjv: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.web: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

verses.he: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־דֹּ֥ור וָדֹֽור׃
verses.ar: مُلْكُكَ مُلْكُ كُلِّ ٱلدُّهُورِ، وَسُلْطَانُكَ فِي كُلِّ دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.en: Thy kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, and Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.kjv: Thy kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations.
verses.web: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

verses.he: סֹומֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זֹוקֵ֗ף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃
verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ عَاضِدٌ كُلَّ ٱلسَّاقِطِينَ، وَمُقَوِّمٌ كُلَّ ٱلْمُنْحَنِينَ.
verses.en: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
verses.kjv: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all [those that be] bowed down.
verses.web: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

verses.he: עֵֽינֵי־כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֹֽותֵן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: أَعْيُنُ ٱلْكُلِّ إِيَّاكَ تَتَرَجَّى، وَأَنْتَ تُعْطِيهِمْ طَعَامَهُمْ فِي حِينِهِ.
verses.en: The eyes of all wait for Thee, and Thou givest them their food in due season.
verses.kjv: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.web: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

verses.he: פֹּותֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֹֽון׃
verses.ar: تَفْتَحُ يَدَكَ فَتُشْبِعُ كُلَّ حَيٍّ رِضًى.
verses.en: Thou openest Thy hand, and satisfiest every living thing with favour.
verses.kjv: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.web: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

verses.he: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ بَارٌّ فِي كُلِّ طُرُقِهِ، وَرَحِيمٌ فِي كُلِّ أَعْمَالِهِ.
verses.en: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, and gracious in all His works.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.web: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

verses.he: קָרֹ֣וב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ قَرِيبٌ لِكُلِّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَهُ، ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَهُ بِٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.en: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, to all that call upon Him in truth.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.web: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

verses.he: רְצֹון־יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיֹושִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.ar: يَعْمَلُ رِضَى خَائِفِيهِ، وَيَسْمَعُ تَضَرُّعَهُمْ، فَيُخَلِّصُهُمْ.
verses.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.kjv: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.web: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.he: שֹׁומֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃
verses.ar: يَحْفَظُ ٱلرَّبُّ كُلَّ مُحِبِّيهِ، وَيُهْلِكُ جَمِيعَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.en: The LORD preserveth all them that love Him; but all the wicked will He destroy.
verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.web: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

verses.he: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל־בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֹׁ֗ו לְעֹולָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.ar: بِتَسْبِيحِ ٱلرَّبِّ يَنْطِقُ فَمِي، وَلْيُبَارِكْ كُلُّ بَشَرٍ ٱسْمَهُ ٱلْقُدُّوسَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; and let all flesh bless His holy name for ever and ever.
verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.web: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
